defect: The new test WriteThreadWaitNanosCounter calls POSIX sleep(2), which is not declared on Windows/MSVC, breaking the Windows build (the fix replaces it with SystemClock::SleepForMicroseconds).
reason: The fix repairs a compile failure on a supported platform (Windows) in lines this change added, and sleep() is visibly POSIX-only in the diff.

defect: Heap-allocated range-tombstone iterators are added to arena-mode MergeIteratorBuilders, so the ScopedArenaIterator only runs their destructors and never frees them, leaking memory (reported by TSAN).
reason: The fix replaces exactly these newly added arena merge builders with heap-allocated merging iterators; seeing it requires knowing that NewRangeTombstoneIterator does not use the arena and how arena-mode MergingIterator frees children.

defect: sorted_keys stores &key_context.back() while key_context (an autovector with 32 inline slots) is still growing, so pointers to elements past 32 dangle after reallocation and Transaction::MultiGet with more than 32 keys crashes.
reason: The fix collects the pointers only after key_context is complete; the pointer-into-a-growing-container bug is in the added line and visible in the diff.

defect: The trivial-move path now calls AddFile with c->level() + 1 instead of c->output_level(), putting moved files into the wrong level whenever the output level is not level+1 (e.g. L0 to the base level with dynamic level bytes).
reason: The diff visibly replaces output_level() with level()+1 (a bad merge), and the fix restores output_level() in exactly those lines.

defect: No functional defect: the added table_file_deletion event is logged regardless of whether DeleteFile succeeds; the fix adds the deletion status to the event and logs failures at ERROR level.
reason: The fix is a logging/diagnostics improvement, not the repair of a wrong result, crash or broken interface.

defect: AddFile allocates a new file number and copies or links the SST into the DB directory without registering it in pending_outputs_, so a concurrent PurgeObsoleteFiles can delete the file while it is being added.
reason: The fix adds CaptureCurrentFileNumberInPendingOutputs/ReleaseFileNumberFromPendingOutputs around the code this change added; the race needs knowledge of the obsolete-file purge mechanism.

defect: The example now calls ToString, which is declared only in the internal util/string_util.h that the example (built against public headers) does not include, so compact_files_example fails to compile.
reason: The fix reverts exactly these two calls to std::to_string; the compile failure was introduced here but seeing it needs the header layout.

defect: The new ChangePrefixExtractor test asserts BLOOM_FILTER_PREFIX_CHECKED counts that the LITE build does not produce, so the test fails in LITE; the fix makes the counter checks conditional.
reason: The fix only changes the test's expectations, which the rules classify as a test change rather than a repaired product defect.

defect: EnvWrapper::ReuseWritableFile in the public env.h overrides a virtual without the override keyword while its sibling methods use it, triggering clang -Winconsistent-missing-override and breaking -Werror clang builds.
reason: The fix adds override to this added declaration; the inconsistency is visible in the diff.

defect: The change enables subcompactions with user-defined timestamps but still builds the ClippingIterator start/end internal keys from boundary keys carrying their actual timestamps, so versions of one user key with higher timestamps fall into the previous subcompaction and a user key is split across subcompactions.
reason: Before this change UDT subcompactions were disabled (assert and ShouldFormSubcompactions guard); the fix sets the bound timestamps to the maximum, repairing the path this change enabled, which requires knowing timestamp ordering in internal keys.

defect: The stress test sets SetInjectUnsyncedDataLoss(false) after DB open while FaultInjectionTestFS checks the flag on every Append, so a WAL created during open mixes buffered and direct writes and reads back as corrupted in the stress test.
reason: The defect and the fix are confined to the stress-test harness and the fault-injection test filesystem, i.e. a test-infrastructure change, not a product defect.

defect: DbStressListener::OnCompactionCompleted overrides an EventListener method without override while OnFlushCompleted uses it, so clang with -Werror,-Winconsistent-missing-override fails to build db_stress.
reason: Compile failure on a supported compiler in lines this change added, visible from the inconsistent override usage in the diff.

defect: The new test's compaction_finished/flush_finished counters are plain ints incremented from background-thread sync-point callbacks and read on the main thread, a data race flagged by TSAN.
reason: The race is confined to test code and the fix only changes the test (atomic counters), which the rules classify as a test change.

defect: CorruptionsTest deletes a corrupt backup without GarbageCollect and then creates a new backup that reuses the ID and leftover files, making the test fail intermittently.
reason: The fix only reorders the test logic; it is a test change, not a repair of the backup engine.

defect: The new BlockReadCountTest declares an unqualified KVMap, which no longer exists after KVMap moved to stl_wrappers::KVMap, so table_test does not compile.
reason: The fix qualifies exactly this added declaration; the mismatch is visible against stl_wrappers::KVMap used in the surrounding code shown in the diff.

defect: No functional defect: the new db_bench flag was spelled --readhead and the fix renames it to --readahead.
reason: The flag worked under its (misspelled) name and was not documented otherwise, so the fix is a naming correction rather than a defect repair.

defect: The new ldb tool calls exit() without including stdlib.h and prints the uint64_t count with %d, causing a compile error and a printf format mismatch (undefined behaviour).
reason: The fix adds stdlib.h and a correct format for exactly these added lines, which are visible in the diff.

defect: The new KeyMayExist test calls PutValues, which flushes the memtable, so KeyMayExist without I/O cannot return the values and the test fails.
reason: The fix only changes the test (PutValues gets a no-flush option); it is a test change.

defect: InterpretOperationProperties uses std::map::emplace, which the libstdc++ of the supported gcc 4.7 lacks, breaking the build there.
reason: The fix replaces exactly these added emplace calls with insert; it is a compile failure on a supported compiler visible in the diff.

defect: The rewritten test calls gen_l0_kb(0, 64) with two arguments while the lambda takes three (start, size, stride), so db_test does not compile (an interim default lambda argument then broke clang on Mac).
reason: The fix supplies the stride argument in exactly these added calls; the arity mismatch is visible in the diff.

defect: MakeBuilder passes a temporary ImmutableCFOptions to NewTableBuilder while PlainTableBuilder keeps a reference to it, so the test uses a dangling reference (ASAN failure).
reason: The defect and fix are confined to test code (the test now keeps the options alive), which the rules classify as a test change.

defect: The new GetOptionsFromStringsTest compares unsigned option fields and size() results with signed int literals in ASSERT_EQ, producing sign-compare errors that break the -Werror build on Mac.
reason: The fix makes the literals unsigned in exactly these added lines; comparisons such as size() against 6 are visibly signed/unsigned in the diff.

defect: The new file defines ParsedInternalKeyComparator in an anonymous namespace, duplicating the struct in range_del_aggregator.cc, so the unity build fails with an ambiguous reference.
reason: The fix removes the duplicate definition this change added; the clash is only visible with range_del_aggregator.cc.

defect: db_bench calls rocksdb::DumpMallocStats unconditionally, but it is only declared when ROCKSDB_LITE is not defined, so the LITE build fails to compile.
reason: The fix wraps the added flag and call in #ifndef ROCKSDB_LITE; seeing it requires db/malloc_stats.h.

defect: The TEST_ helper functions are compiled only under #ifndef NDEBUG (here and in db_impl.h), so make release, which builds the tests with NDEBUG, fails to compile and link the callers of these helpers.
reason: The fix changes the guard to ROCKSDB_LITE; recognizing the break requires knowing that release builds compile the tests that call these helpers.

defect: The upper-bound trimming makes UpdateCurrent reset valid_ when the current key passes iterate_upper_bound, so NeedToSeekImmutable always returns true and tailing Seek() needlessly re-seeks immutable iterators, a large performance regression.
reason: The fix (removing NeedToRebuildTrimmed and smallest_file_key_bound, adding current_over_upper_bound_) repairs a regression this change introduced; the mechanism lives in forward_iterator.cc.

defect: prefix_buf is char[5] (shrunk from 6 in Verify) for snprintf with %.4u of set_i + 1, whose value can need five digits, which can truncate and fails GCC 7 -Werror=format-truncation.
reason: The fix enlarges exactly these buffers to 6; the undersized buffer is visible in the diff.

defect: MutableCFOptions::Dump prints size_t fields with PRIu64, a format mismatch that breaks the -Werror build on Mac where size_t and uint64_t are different types.
reason: The fix switches these added format specifiers to %zu; the field types are declared in mutable_cf_options.h.

defect: The new Level1Trigger2 test relies on the unspecified order in which files of equal size are sorted, so its expectations depend on the STL implementation.
reason: The fix only adjusts test data; it is a test change.

defect: Removing t_cnt from the lambda capture list while still using it inside the lambda makes MSVC (AppVeyor) reject the code, breaking the Windows build.
reason: The fix switches to default capture; the use of an uncaptured local is visible in the changed line.

defect: No functional defect: !Compare(...) == 0 evaluates the same as Compare(...) != 0; the fix only rewrites it to silence a warning added by a newer Mac clang.
reason: The expression computes the intended result, so the later fix is a style/warning cleanup prompted by a newer compiler.

defect: return std::move(ss.str()) and std::move on the temporary returned by Stats() trigger clang -Wpessimizing-move, breaking -Werror clang builds.
reason: The fix removes exactly these added std::move calls; the pattern is visible in the diff.

defect: IsSupportedChecksumType compares type >= kNoChecksum where kNoChecksum is 0 on an unsigned enum type, which is always true and fails GCC -Werror=type-limits in CI.
reason: The fix rewrites this added comparison; knowing it is always true requires the ChecksumType definition.

defect: The rewritten assert still refers to m, which no longer exists after the loop was changed to use indices, so debug builds fail to compile.
reason: The fix replaces m with mems[i] in the added assert; the undeclared name is visible in the diff.

defect: WriteToWAL evaluates assert(alive_log_files_tail_ != alive_log_files_.rend()) without holding the DB or log mutex outside clang TSAN builds, racing with concurrent pop_front on alive_log_files_.
reason: The fix makes this added assert conditional on holding a mutex; the compiler-specific guard in the diff shows the access can be unprotected.

defect: The new PauseBackgroundWorkTest reads std::atomic<bool> done before it is initialized (valgrind uninitialised-value report).
reason: The defect and fix are confined to test code, which the rules classify as a test change.

defect: The test includes <strings.h> and calls strcasecmp, which do not exist on Windows, breaking the Windows build of ldb_cmd_test.
reason: The fix replaces them with EXPECT_STRCASEEQ; the POSIX-only header is visible in the diff.

defect: AbortIO now passes (void*)1 as the user_data to cancel, so the cancel targets user_data 1 instead of the pending request, and the void* argument still does not compile with newer liburing where the parameter is __u64.
reason: The fix sets sqe->addr to the handle; the wrong cancel target is visible in the changed line.

defect: No functional defect: the new buggy-kernel warning is printed to stderr on every file Close, which the crash-test harness treats as a failure; the fix prints it once with a WARNING prefix and filters it in db_crashtest.py.
reason: The fix adjusts diagnostic output and the test-harness filter; the ftruncate check and punch-hole behaviour were correct.

defect: RandomString(&rnd, options.bytes_per_sync / 2) narrows a uint64_t to int, which MSVC treats as an error, breaking the Windows build.
reason: The fix adds static_cast<int>, as the sibling test in the same diff already does, so the defect is visible in the diff.
